tablea.description: Tablea is an authentic pinoy chocate made with locally farmed Cacao. It can be served melted and hot, bite size or as a main ingredient of a Pinoy loved meryenda called Champorado. Tablea or Tabliya are will distributed all throughout the archipelago, some are from Bohol while Mabini, Batangas has its own version.
